verdicts.reason: Both versions keep the original's illustration strip as one band, without rearranging it, and enlarge the CLAYTONI headline until it runs straight over the busy figures at both edges. The graphics also stop at a hard flat cut along the bottom, with a dead navy band above. A is worse: the 'CREATIVE AGENCY' subtitle sits right on the bottom of the illustrations and the cut edge. B moves the subtitle below the strip onto plain background, so it reads cleanly, but the headline collisions and empty top band are still there.
